about: Log 405 held-out set, written 2026-10-11 before any run of it. Gold verdicts follow capability_sheet.yaml. Families: CP results one workflow gives, phrased through a less common output (p-values, enrichment, core scores, activity tests, survival, covariate shares) or added in a second turn -- where routing fell back or failed on heldout12; CN near misses of the kinds older checks over-credited (regulator kinds, structure, reversed roles, miRNA sign, overlapping groups, dynamics, off-domain, three layers, per-sample sign); P one supported and one unsupported result; CE plain requests routing matches exactly (controls). K items send their second turn with --resume.
